top_themes.label: Trading & orders
top_themes.summary: Users report technical glitches during order execution, high brokerage fees, and missing features like pre‑market sell and chart tools.

top_themes.label: Onboarding & demat
top_themes.summary: New investors appreciate the app’s ease, yet demat account opening delays and unresponsive support cause significant frustration.

top_themes.label: Withdrawals & payouts
top_themes.summary: Withdrawal attempts often lack SMS or UPI confirmations, leaving users uncertain whether the transaction succeeded.

actions.title: Add Pre‑Market Sell Feature
actions.detail: Implement pre‑market sell for SME IPOs and improve chart UI to prevent full‑screen glitches.

actions.title: Accelerate Demat Account Opening
actions.detail: Streamline KYC workflow and set clear timelines, with automated status updates to reduce support delays.

actions.title: Enable Withdrawal Confirmation Alerts
actions.detail: Send immediate SMS and in‑app UPI notifications for every withdrawal request to assure users of processing.
